input.entry_router: M125 required portfolio-risk-gated paper router JSON
input.marks: One or more M117-compatible mark snapshot JSON files

loop_steps: Build M119-compatible paper mark-to-market time-series from M125 positions and mark snapshots.
Build M122-compatible current paper portfolio state from entry fills, optional paper exits, and latest marks.
Build M123-compatible paper portfolio risk state from the current portfolio state.
Expose the M123-compatible risk state as the next M124 entry gate input.

safety.description: M126 links simulated fills, paper marks, paper portfolio state, and paper risk state for next-cycle gating only. It does not call broker order APIs, submit orders, transmit orders, or mutate a real portfolio.
